title: Job
description: A data processing job that executes on the Xceptor platform. Jobs represent units of work such as document ingestion, data extraction, transformation, or export operations.

id.description: The unique identifier of the job

status.description: The current processing status of the job

progress.description: The processing progress as a percentage (0-100)

created_at.description: The date and time the job was created

updated_at.description: The date and time the job was last updated

completed_at.description: The date and time the job completed processing

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the job
